changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_habilitation_sujet CHECK ( (sujet_type = 'UTILISATEUR' AND utilisateur_id IS NOT NULL AND groupe_ged_id IS NULL AND application_id IS NULL) OR (sujet_type = 'GROUPE' AND groupe_ged_id IS NOT NULL AND utilisateur_id IS NULL AND application_id IS NULL) OR (sujet_type = 'APPLICATION' AND application_id IS NOT NULL AND utilisateur_id IS NULL AND groupe_ged_id IS NULL))
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_habilitation_cible CHECK (noeud_id IS NULL OR document_id IS NULL)
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_habilitation_role CHECK (role_id IS NOT NULL OR rupture_heritage)
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_habilitation_rupture CHECK (NOT rupture_heritage OR noeud_id IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_habilitation_sujet_role_cible ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation (sujet_type, coalesce(utilisateur_id, groupe_ged_id, application_id), coalesce(role_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'), coalesce(noeud_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'), coalesce(document_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))

changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Reprise de utilisateur_role et access_group_workspace en habilitations.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation (id, sujet_type, utilisateur_id, role_id, rupture_heritage, cree_par, cree_le) SELECT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7(), 'UTILISATEUR', utilisateur_id, role_id, false, attribue_par, attribue_le FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.utilisateur_role

INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation (id, sujet_type, groupe_ged_id, role_id, noeud_id, rupture_heritage) SELECT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7(), 'GROUPE', groupe_ged_id, '0192a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000004', noeud_id, false FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.access_group_workspace

rollback.sql: CREATE TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.access_group_workspace ( id UUID DEFAULT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7() NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_access_group_workspace PRIMARY KEY, groupe_ged_id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_access_group_workspace_groupe_ged REFERENCES ${database.defaultSchemaName}.groupe_ged (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, noeud_id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_access_group_workspace_workspace REFERENCES ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uk_access_group_workspace_access_group_id_workspace_id UNIQUE (groupe_ged_id, noeud_id))

INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.access_group_workspace (groupe_ged_id, noeud_id) SELECT DISTINCT groupe_ged_id, noeud_id FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation WHERE sujet_type = 'GROUPE' AND noeud_id IS NOT NULL AND role_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.utilisateur_role ( id UUID DEFAULT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7() NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pk_utilisateur_role PRIMARY KEY, utilisateur_id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_utilisateur_role_utilisateur REFERENCES ${database.defaultSchemaName}.utilisateur (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, role_id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT fk_utilisateur_role_role REFERENCES ${database.defaultSchemaName}.role (id), attribue_le TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, attribue_par UUID CONSTRAINT fk_utilisateur_role_attribue_par REFERENCES ${database.defaultSchemaName}.utilisateur (id), CONSTRAINT uk_utilisateur_role_utilisateur_id_role_id UNIQUE (utilisateur_id, role_id))

INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.utilisateur_role (utilisateur_id, role_id, attribue_le, attribue_par) SELECT DISTINCT ON (utilisateur_id, role_id) utilisateur_id, role_id, cree_le, cree_par FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.habilitation WHERE sujet_type = 'UTILISATEUR' AND noeud_id IS NULL AND document_id IS NULL AND role_id IS NOT NULL
